input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email link is built from BASE_URL, which falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever the PUBLIC_URL environment variable isn't set:

    const BASE_URL = process.env.PUBLIC_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000";

If PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment (likely something that regressed or was missed in last week's release), every generated link—including password reset, rollup, and scheduled export links—will point to localhost instead of the real deployment URL. This should be fixed by ensuring PUBLIC_URL is set correctly in the production environment/config.
